provider_organization: Commonwealth Scholarship Commission in the UK (CSC), funded by the UK FCDO
eligible_nationalities: Other eligible low and middle income Commonwealth countries (list on the CSC page)

financial_coverage.tuition_coverage: Full tuition fees, by agreement between the CSC and the university

stipend.notes: GBP 1,712 a month, or GBP 2,000 a month at universities in the London area (current CSC rates)

additional_benefits: Child allowance for single, widowed or divorced parents with children in the UK

application_fee.notes: No fee is mentioned on the CSC page or in the Nigerian ministry notice.

eligibility_criteria.min_gpa: First degree of at least upper second class (2:1), or a lower second plus a relevant postgraduate qualification, by September 2027

country_specific_notes.note: Apply both on CSC Central and to the national nominator, the Federal Ministry of Education (Department of Scholarship Awards, formerly Federal Scholarship Board), through its online system. The 2026 ministry notice asked for admission to at least two UK universities and proof of NYSC.

required_documents.name: Passport or national ID card
required_documents.detail: Must show photo, date of birth and citizenship

required_documents.name: Transcripts for all higher education qualifications
required_documents.detail: Certified translations if not in English; missing transcripts make the application ineligible

required_documents.name: Two signed references
required_documents.detail: PDF on institutional letterhead, or sent from an email showing the sender's details

required_documents.name: Admission letters from UK universities
required_documents.detail: Nigerian nominator only: at least two UK universities

preparation_alerts: Nigerian applicants must also apply to the Federal Ministry of Education, whose deadline can be earlier than the CSC deadline
Get transcripts and signed references early; incomplete transcripts make the application ineligible
Secure admission to UK universities before the Nigerian nomination deadline

criteria.criterion: Potential impact on the development of the home country

source_urls.title: CSC: Commonwealth Master's Scholarships
source_urls.used_for: Eligibility, countries, funding, documents, selection criteria, deadline

source_urls.title: Leadership: Federal Ministry of Education notice 2027/28
source_urls.used_for: Nigerian nominator, NYSC and UK admission requirements

verification_status.verification_notes: CSC page confirms Nigeria eligible, deadline 16:00 BST 20 Oct (2026 for the 2027/28 round), stipend rates and documents. Nigerian ministry rules come from a newspaper report of the ministry notice; the ministry's own notice was not found. Secondary sites say the CSC portal opened 8 Sep 2026; not confirmed officially, so opening_date is null. Leads.csv had this scheme twice (rows for Commonwealth Master's and Commonwealth Scholarships UK). The Commonwealth PhD scheme is a separate award and not covered here.
